name: 100 Cute Robots
description: 100 cute chibi toy robots, glossy and colourful, true to scale for a 5-stud character: helper bots, worker bots, wheeled and tracked bots, flying bots, animal bots, battle bots, retro bots, tiny 2-stud bots, six giant boss mechs up to 16 studs and 10 props. Every robot has a screen or simple-eye face that blinks and a battery / power core that is its own detachable part sitting in a modelled socket, like a vinyl collectible. Every wheel is its own part. One shared rig and animation set (same bone and action names as the Cute Zombies and Cute Dinos packs): Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Blink, Hit, Fall, Wave, Attack, Cheer, PowerDown, PowerUp, Dance, Spin, Drive, Fire, Stomp, CorePop and HeadPop. Humanoid bots are set up as playable StarterCharacters by PackSetup. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Sports Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly sports assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 0.3-stud tennis ball to a 40-stud floodlight tower. Balls, bats, rackets, medals and trophies, full-size goals, hoops, nets and posts, track and sideline gear, a whole gym, bleachers, stadium seats, ticket booth, turnstile, ice resurfacer, golf cart, skate ramps, pool, bowling and arcade pieces. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: a soccer goal is 20 wide, the basketball rim is 8.5 up. Every wheel is its own part; hoop nets, turnstile, pedals, punching bags, diving board, barrier and locker door have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 School Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly school assets for school roleplay and school-escape games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud eraser to a 29-stud school bus and a 22-stud bell tower. Classroom desks, boards, globe and doors, backpacks and supplies, science lab, hallway lockers, stairs and double doors, cafeteria, library, music room, principal and nurse offices, and the school yard. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: doors clear 7.5 studs. Every wheel is its own part; doors, locker doors, the desk lid, clock hand, bell hammer, globe, fan and pottery wheel have bones. No text, flags or logos. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Mining & Ore Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly mining assets for simulators and tycoons, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud cut gem to a 16-stud drill rig. 18 ore nodes with real embedded nuggets and crystals (coal to mythic rainbow), loose ore chunks, ingots, cut gems, boulders, stalagmites, cave wall and arch, geodes, 8 pickaxe tiers, drills, dynamite, detonator, lantern, backpacks, crusher, smelter, conveyor, sorter, drill rig, pump, generator, sell station, rails, mine carts, elevator, ladder, rope bridge and signs. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every mine cart wheel is its own part; drill bits, the crusher jaw, the elevator cage and the detonator plunger have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Hospital Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly hospital assets for hospital, clinic and doctor roleplay games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud thermometer to a 19-stud ambulance and a 24-stud entrance canopy. Reception and waiting room, patient room, exam and treatment, surgery and imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray), lab and pharmacy, staff and utility carts, doors, walls and signs, ambulance and helipad. Clean, bright and friendly. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: doors clear 7.6 studs. Every wheel is its own part; doors, bed back-rest, curtain, MRI table, barrier, centrifuge and beacon have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Fishing & Harbor Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly fishing and harbour assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud tin can to a 44-stud lighthouse. Eight fishing rod tiers from stick-and-string to mythic, reel, bobbers, lures, tackle boxes, nets, traps, buoys and anchor; fish crates, barrels, market stall, smokehouse, aquarium and junk catches; ten boats from kayak to trawler and tugboat; modular docks, pilings, boat lift and ramp; lighthouse, crane, bait shop, boathouse, forklift and carts; reeds, lily pads, rocks, campfire and tent. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: dock decks are 8 wide and 3.2 up, a rowboat is 13 long. Every wheel is its own part; rods cast, reels crank, propellers spin, lids, doors, crane, boat lift, forks and the lighthouse lamp have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Zombie Apocalypse
description: 100 cute chibi zombie apocalypse assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character: 20 small playable survivors, 40 zombies, mad scientist zombies, skeletons, imps, 8 huge bosses and 10 props. Every monster does a HUGE snappy chomp (jaw and top of the head split wide open, with teeth and tongue) and has a pink cartoon brain that is its own detachable part, like a vinyl collectible. One shared rig and animation set: Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Blink, Wave, Attack, Hit, Cheer, ZombieWalk, Chomp, Roar, BrainPop, Fall and Slam. Survivors are set up as playable StarterCharacters by PackSetup. Cute, never gory. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Dinosaurs
description: 100 cute chubby low-poly dinosaurs and prehistoric animals with blinking faces, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from 2-stud babies to a 25-stud Brachiosaurus. T-Rex, Raptor, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Brontosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus, Pterodactyl, Mosasaurus, Mammoth, Sabertooth, Dodo and many more, plus colour variants, babies, hatchlings, eggs, a nest, bones and fossils. Happy, neutral and angry faces. Head, jaw, tail and wing bones with Idle, Blink, Bite, Roar and Flap animations. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Construction Site Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly construction site assets for building, demolition and city tycoon games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 2-stud pair of goggles to a 78-stud tower crane. Excavator, bulldozer, dump truck, mixer truck, mobile and tower crane, forklift, road roller, loader, backhoe, skid steer, telehandler, trucks and lifts; scaffolding, steel, rebar, concrete, brick and timber pieces on a 12-stud grid; pallets and piles of materials; hand tools and safety gear; site office, containers, generators, tanks and a wrecking ball. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part; cabs swing, booms, buckets, blades, beds, drums, forks, hooks, platforms, doors, gates and lids have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Camping & Outdoor Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly camping and outdoor assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character, for camping, survival, hiking and summer-camp games: tents, cabins, a ranger station and fire lookout, an RV, pop-up trailer and camper van, campfires and camp cooking, backpacks and hiking gear, trail signs, bridges, a camp gate, canoes, an archery target, zipline and swings, plus pines, logs, boulders and forest plants. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part and every fire is its own Flame part; tent flaps, doors, lids, the gate, the pump handle, the lantern and the swings have bones and actions. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Tower Defense Assets
description: Everything for a tower defense game in the sharp studded style: 15 towers with 3 upgrade levels each, 30 enemies and bosses, and 25 path tiles and map props on an 8-stud grid. Real scale for a 5-stud character. One texture, rigged (Turret, Barrel, Recoil, Spin; Torso, Head, arms, legs, wings) with shared Idle, Fire, Spin, Walk and Attack animations.

name: 100 Stud World Assets
description: Sharp, blocky, studded world props in five biomes: forest, winter, desert, buildings and samurai. True scale for a 5-stud character, from 1 to 40 studs. One texture, rigged, with Idle, Open and Ring animations.

name: 100 Stud Pets
description: Blocky, studded voxel pets for pet-simulator games: farm, forest, safari, ocean, bugs, dinos and mythics. 2 to 12 studs for a 5-stud character. One texture, rigged (Body, Head, Jaw, Tail, legs, wings, ears, Float) with shared Idle, Walk, Fly and Jump animations.

name: 100 Stud Halloween Assets
description: Sharp, blocky, studded Halloween and graveyard props at real stud scale: crypts and mausoleums with glowing purple windows, a haunted house, gravestones, coffins, iron fences and gates, dead trees, jack-o-lanterns, ghosts, skulls, webs, cauldrons, lamps and candy. One texture. Root-rigged, with Idle, Open (gates, coffin lids) and Flap (bat) animations.

name: 100 Stud Eggs
description: 100 hatching eggs built from stacked stud cubes: animals, dragons, characters, treats, elements, special eggs and egg stands. About 4 to 5 studs tall for a 5-stud character. One texture, rigged (Egg, Top, Float) with shared Idle, Wobble and Hatch animations.

name: 50 Studded Bosses
description: 50 sharp, blocky boss monsters covered in classic studs, 17 to 40 studs tall for a 5-stud character: undead, golems, beasts, dragons, machines, warriors, royals and mages. One texture, no outline. Rigged with the same bones on every boss (Torso, Head, Jaw, arms, hands, legs, Float for crowns and crystals) and shared Idle, Attack and Roar animations.

name: 200 Pixel Items
description: 200 items as full 3D voxel models for drops, pickups and inventories: food, drinks and potions, ores and ingots, coins and gems, crafting materials, farming, magic, loot containers, music and misc, tech. 1 voxel = 0.125 stud, items are 1 to 2.5 studs across and sculpted all the way round. One texture, rigged and animated (Idle bob and spin, Pickup).

name: 100 Voxel Village Builds
description: 100 voxel village assets: ten enterable houses, fifteen service buildings (forge, bakery, tavern, town hall, windmill, watermill, lighthouse ...), walls and gates, paths, bridges and street props, crop fields in growth stages, interior furniture and decorations. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud for a 5-stud character; a full block is 2 studs and the pixel art is 8 px per stud on every asset; doorways are 4 studs wide and 6 tall; everything snaps to the 2-stud block grid. One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Voxel Vehicles
description: 100 blocky voxel vehicles in bright flat colours with pixel-art shading: cars, trucks and service vehicles, bikes and carts, trains with rail pieces, boats, aircraft, spacecraft and fantasy rides. True stud scale for a 5 stud character: 1 voxel = 0.5 stud (0.25 stud on the small ride-ons). Every wheel is its own part with a bone on the axle. One texture, rigged and animated.

name: 150 Voxel Tools & Armor
description: 150 voxel tools, weapons and armour pieces in a bright pixel-art style, in ten material tiers that each have their own shapes: Wood, Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold, Crystal, Emerald, Obsidian, Magma and Void. Every tier has a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, dagger, hammer, spear and bow, plus a helmet, armor, pants and boots that fit a blocky 5 stud character, and there are 20 extras: shields, buckets, torch, lantern, compass, clock, map and more. 1 voxel = 0.1 stud. Every tool has its grip at the same place, so one hold animation fits all. One texture, rigged and animated.

name: 160 Pixel Guns
description: 160 full 3D voxel weapons in a bright pixel-art style: rifles, SMGs, shotguns, pistols, swords, hammers, scythes, bows, staffs, ray guns, snipers, crossbows, launchers and miniguns, including 36 legendary weapons with wings, jaws and orbiting parts. One texture, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Voxel Mobs
description: 100 blocky voxel creatures with painted pixel-art skins: farm animals, wild animals, sea life, hostile monsters, villagers and traders, nether and void creatures and ten large bosses. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud for a 5-stud character; the pixel art is 8 px per stud on every mob (1 px = 0.125 stud). Animals are 1 to 5 studs, humanoids 5 to 6, bosses 12 to 30. One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged with shared bone names (Root, Float, Body, Head, Jaw, Tail, ArmL/R, LegL/R, LegFL/FR/BL/BR, WingL/R) and shared actions (Idle, Walk, Attack, Fly, Hurt, Hop).

name: 100 Voxel Sky Islands

One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged and animated.

name: 150 Voxel Furniture

True scale for a 5-stud character (1 unit = 1 stud, 1 voxel = 0.25 stud: seats at 2 studs, tables at 3, doors 4 x 7). One palette texture, rigged (doors, drawers, lids, spinning and swinging parts) and animated.

name: 100 Voxel Dungeon Kit
description: 100 voxel dungeon crawler assets: modular rooms and corridors on a 16-stud grid, ten complete set-piece rooms, doors and gates, traps, chests and loot, spawners and altars, and decor. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud for a 5-stud character; a full block is 2 studs and the pixel art is 8 px per stud on every asset; corridors are 8 studs wide and 12 tall inside, rooms are up to 64 studs across. One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Voxel City Builds
description: 100 voxel city builder assets: road tiles on a 32-stud grid, homes, shops, services, towers and landmarks, street props, static vehicles and rooftop bits. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud for a 5-stud character; a full block is 2 studs and the pixel art is 8 px per stud on every asset; road tiles are 32 x 32 studs with two 12-stud lanes, doors are 4 x 6 studs, towers reach 120 studs. One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Voxel Characters
description: 100 blocky voxel characters and NPC skins: medieval, adventurers, modern jobs, fantasy races, sci-fi, kids and teens, festive and five bosses. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud; a normal character is 5.25 studs tall (head a 1.25 cube, torso 2, arms and legs 1 wide and 2 tall); painted skins with clothes, hair and gear raised as real voxels, 8 px per stud; bosses are the same rig scaled 1.6 to 2 times. One material, one pixel-art atlas, one shared rig with Idle, Walk, Run, Wave, Attack and Sit.

name: 100 Voxel Biome Kit
description: 100 voxel overworld assets in 10 biomes (plains, forest, autumn forest, desert, snow tundra, jungle, swamp, mushroom fields, volcanic wasteland, crystal caves). Each biome has 3 terrain chunks (flat, hill, cliff), 1 landmark, 3 trees or large plants and 3 small props. Scale: 1 unit = 1 stud for a 5-stud character; a full block is 2 studs and the pixel art is 8 px per stud on every asset. Terrain chunks are 32 x 32 studs and every chunk edge is 8 studs high, so chunks of all biomes tile on a 32-stud grid; a cliff chunk is 20 studs high on its far edge and joins other cliffs sideways. One material, one pixel-art atlas texture, rigged (Root, Float, Flow) and animated.

name: 100 Factory Machines
description: 100 stylized toy-factory assets for tycoon and simulator games, true to scale for a 5-stud character (1 Blender unit = 1 stud): conveyors that tile on a 4-stud grid with moving belts, fat pipes that connect flange to flange with a lump of stuff visibly pumping through, 28 machines with spinning gears, stamping presses, shaking hoppers, robot arms and bobbing chimney caps, tanks, silos and vats, push buttons, levers, valve wheels and gauges that animate, plus crates, barrels, ingots, catwalks and floor tiles. Models and bone animations only: no scripts, no particles. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Lucky Blocks
description: 70 studded lucky blocks (rarity tiers, elements, themes, creatures, special shapes) and 30 supporting pieces: pads, pedestals, conveyor, drop tube, breaking tools, loot and arena parts. Real stud scale for a 5-stud character. One texture, rigged (Block, Lid, Float) with shared Idle, Shake and Open animations.

name: 100 Kart Racing Assets

Track tiles are 28 studs wide and snap together: straight, finish line, curve and ramp, plus start arch, start lights, curbs, boost pads, item boxes, tyre walls, cones, pit props, grandstand, podium and trophies. One palette texture. Drive, Idle, Boost, Steer, Spin and Flap animations.

Glass is its own part; doors, the rotating pedestal, the round rack, the curtain, the register drawer and the spotlight have bones and actions. Signs and boards are blank. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Halloween Creatures

name: 25 Dark RPG Monsters
description: 25 dark fantasy monsters and bosses for RPGs: a club-swinging cyclops, drowned giant, crab titan, leviathan eel and a crowned eldritch king, plus brutes, stalkers, beasts and crawlers. Every monster also has a second, studded look on the same UVs (tex/<Name>_stud.png with its own normal and roughness maps); in Blender, use_stud.py switches all 25 materials between the two.

name: 100 Cute Restaurant Assets
